title: Bound 168-term alternating-plane decoders at COPY mass 672
body:
The two-direction port search produced a scoped obstruction, not a new kappa. For the 336 nondegenerate alternating planes in the even subspace of F2^7, the fitting family I+cA has minimum real rank 168 at c=-1/2. Every factorization of that matrix with exactly 168 scalar terms has additive full-plane COPY mass at least 672, which uses its entire two-coordinate allowance.

The proof uses an exact graph polynomial and all 651 four-space principal minors. A nonzero factor in the matrix image must span at least five binary dimensions; each source/reader pair therefore costs at least four. The 336-term column factorization gives a cost-672 control. Overcomplete factorizations and other fitting matrices remain open. No complete supplier, BIT gain or outer kappa is claimed.

Validation: normal and optimized registered CPython 3.12.13 replays, four rejection controls, committed-byte comparison, official export integrity and normal/optimized read-only Git-free replays pass. A forged cost-671 receipt is rejected. Source pins pass; the optional full-ancestry check refused the shallow checkout. Hosted CI and independent review are pending.

Base: canonical main `6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63`. The selected result and predecessors are unchanged. Coordination and overlap: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5620 . The native alternating-plane operator and full-plane tariff are credited to their predecessors; the claimed contribution is this finite spectrum/support certificate and its scoped cost theorem.

Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
